claims: Luke Murray is Bill Murray's son.
Luke Murray served as an assistant coach at UConn from 2021 to 2024.
Luke Murray was a key assistant under Dan Hurley at UConn.
Luke Murray's coaching career previously included stints at Xavier and Louisville.
Luke Murray was named the head coach at Boston College in March 2026, says Men's Journal.
Bill Murray celebrated back-to-back national championships with the UConn Huskies men’s basketball team in 2023 and 2024.
Bill Murray was a presence in the stands during the 2023 and 2024 NCAA tournaments.
Men's Journal reports that videos of Bill Murray's celebrations frequently went viral.
Bill Murray was on the court celebrating with the UConn team during UConn's recent national title runs.
The Tuscaloosa News notes that Bill Murray has been a regular at games to support Luke Murray's coaching career.
